correctness.rationale: For any zero vertex the neighbor-label sum is exactly a shore sum, minus its deleted mate when applicable. If both shores contain zeros, a function of weight at most three is impossible. Exhausting the only remaining all-positive-shore cases yields exactly the stated weight-two and weight-three exceptions; a universal weight-four construction covers all others. At weight four, shore sums two and two force matched support synchronization, and the only all-positive-shore corrections are (3,3,2) and (3,4,3); 2K2 gives the separate nine-function case. The standalone exhaustive checker agrees on every tested parameter triple.

value.rationale: The family is a canonical controlled perturbation of complete bipartite graphs, directly aligned with current work on perfect Italian domination in structured bipartite classes. The result gives more than another isolated exact value: it identifies every low-weight phase, a structural synchronization law for all generic minima, and a closed minimizer count with sharp small exceptions. These features expose how exact-neighbor-sum domination reacts to independent edge defects.
